query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS minimax_usage (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            ts         TEXT    NOT NULL,
            source     TEXT    NOT NULL,
            purpose    TEXT,
            model      TEXT,
            tokens_in  INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            tokens_out INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            total      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            success    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
            meta       TEXT
        )
